events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) sets the pick on Fox (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact with Gasol's (MEM) front at the start of his drive.
Fox (SAC) makes clean contact with the ball during Gasol's (MEM) drive.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bjelica (SAC) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor at the start of his dribble.
Shumpert (SAC) sets the back screen on Jackson Jr. (MEM), who is stationary, and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes incidental contact with Bjelica (SAC) during rebounding.
RLB shows Green (MEM) legally contests Hield's (SAC) shot attempt near the rim.

LLS shows Bjelica (SAC) makes slight contact with the back of Mack's (MEM) head during rebounding. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
LAR and RAR show Green (MEM) reaches in and makes contact with Fox's (SAC) left arm at the end of the drive and affects his ability to make the pass.
Bjelica (SAC) turns his body into Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) and makes contact that affects his shot attempt.
Green (MEM) makes marginal contact with Shumpert's (SAC) front at the start of the drive, which does not affect his SQBR.
LLS shows Green (MEM) extends his forearm against Shumpert's (SAC) side as he is airborne and makes contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact with Gasol's (MEM) arm during rebounding.
[Observable in enhanced video] Green (MEM) enters the lane prior to the release of Shumpert's (SAC) free throw attempt.
Fox (SAC) briefly makes contact with his hand to Conley's (MEM) front along the perimeter, but it is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
LAR shows Fox (SAC) makes slight contact with Conley's (MEM) left arm as he is airborne, but it is marginal in nature.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) commits the take foul on Fox (SAC).
Hield (SAC) makes marginal contact with Mack (MEM) after his gather.
Conley (MEM) makes marginal contact with Fox (SAC) through the pick and near the free throw line, which does not affect his SQBR.
RLB shows Conley (MEM) makes slight contact with Fox's (SAC) left elbow after he releases his jump shot attempt, but does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
Gasol (MEM) sets the screen on Fox (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.

Mack (MEM) places both arms around Hield's (SAC) midsection and restricts his FOM along the sideline. A foul is signaled on the floor, followed by a signal for a jump ball. The officials on the floor conference and determine that the illegal contact occurred prior to any possible held ball and the foul is correctly called.
